output.summary: An annual herb probably native to Central America, jimsonweed has night-opening trumpet-shaped flowers and egg-shaped seed capsules that may be spiny. It is poisonous: all parts contain dangerous tropane alkaloids, and ingestion can cause delirium, hallucinations and potentially fatal poisoning.
output.edibilityNote: All parts contain dangerous tropane alkaloids; ingestion can cause severe poisoning and carries a high risk of fatal overdose.
